name: The Heart Attacks

tenures.source: Tournament to the Title (1 February 2009), where Tails and Frank Hart win the World Tag Team Titles and are billed as The Heart Attacks.

caption: Tails and Frank Hart, the first NLWF World Tag Team Champions.

name: The Asylum

tenures.source: Direct Hit 1 (17 January 2009) names the Asylum and Havoc leads it through the spring; Cipher joins on 1 February, Shayne Wolf and Shadow Demon appear with it, King of DX joins on Legacy 3.

caption: Havoc's stable, whose members included Cipher, Death Angel, Shadow Demon, Shayne Wolf and King of DX in turn.

identity.note: The same name stands on another wing's record; nothing on this wing's pages ties the two.

name: The New Design

tenures.source: Direct Hit 2 and Direct Hit 3 (January and February 2009), where Johnny Styles and Cyber Punk team and are named the New Design on Direct Hit 4.

caption: Johnny Styles and Cyber Punk, a team of the two JWF-era stars on Direct Hit.

name: One World Nation

tenures.source: Direct Hit 4 and Direct Hit 5 (February 2009), where the page bills Chuck Matthews and Brenton Cyrus as One World Nation.

caption: Chuck Matthews and Brenton Cyrus as a tag team on Direct Hit.

name: Salvation

tenures.source: Direct Hit 6 to Direct Hit 12 (March to May 2009), which name Salvation as Brenton Cyrus's following and show Chuck Matthews and Alex Mark in it.

caption: Brenton Cyrus's following on Direct Hit, with Chuck Matthews and Alex Mark, which holds every East title by the end of April 2009.

name: DX Affliction

tenures.source: Direct Hit 6 (7 March 2009), where Carmine Vestieri presents Joe Santiago and Johnny Styles as DX Affliction.

caption: Joe Santiago and Johnny Styles, the team that won the Universal Tag Team Titles on Direct Hit 6.

name: The Straight Edge Gunners

tenures.source: Direct Hit 1 (17 January 2009) and Tournament to the Title, which bill the brothers Johnny and Bart Bloodstone as the Straight Edge Gunners.

caption: The brothers Johnny and Bart Bloodstone, the first World Tag Team challengers.

name: 25 to Life

tenures.source: Legacy 11 (21 June 2009), which calls Brenton Cyrus and The Mexican Samurai the tag champions 25 to Life; its news page says the team formed on the Legacy show after Cyrus's trade.

caption: Brenton Cyrus and The Mexican Samurai, the tag champions of Legacy in June 2009.

name: Pulp Fiction

tenures.source: Legacy 3 (4 April 2009), which names Bert Hales and C.W. Gibson, the 'Pulp Fiction' team, as general managers of Legacy.

caption: Bert Hales and C.W. Gibson, the general managers of Legacy.

name: The New Dawn

tenures.source: The one-year show of 18 January 2010, which introduces Carmine Vestieri 'representing the New Dawn' and names Steven Angel and Corey Casey as its members.

caption: Carmine Vestieri's group of early 2010, with Steven Angel and Corey Casey.
